/kind feature
/kind api-change
<!--
Add one of the following kinds:
/kind bug

/kind flake

#### What this PR does / why we need it:
The root directory for pod logs is `/var/log/pods` as default, and doesn't support modification.
Sometimes we want container logs to be output to a specified place according to the disk usage plan.
I suggest that provide users with ability to set `podLogsRootDirectory`.
#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:

-->

-->

```release-note
Provide a flag --pod-logs-directory to set the root directory for pod logs
```

I applied this patch to a cluster on kind for testing. It seems work fine.
The configuration for kind is below.
```YAML
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
nodes:
- role: control-plane
  image: kind-image:pod-logs-dir
- role: worker
  image: kind-image:pod-logs-dir
  kubeadmConfigPatches:
  - |
    kind: JoinConfiguration
    nodeRegistration:
      kubeletExtraArgs:
        pod-logs-directory: "/home/test/log/pods"
```

issue_context.title: Add a new --pod-logs-directory flag to Kubelet
issue_context.body:
### What would you like to be added?

Add a new --pod-logs-directory flag to Kubelet.
Provide users with ability to set `podLogsRootDirectory`.

### Why is this needed?

The root directory for pod logs is `/var/log/pods` as default, and doesn't support modification.
Sometimes we want container logs to be output to a specified place according to the disk usage plan.

Actually, docker outputs container logs to its workspace, and then creates symlink to  `/var/log/pods` (dockershim does). That's ok.
After runtime switchs to others, like containerd, we should provide a way to set `podLogsRootDirectory`.

review_comments: We should include the default value in the documentation.
I think this is a dangerous change; we shouldn't swap out the const to a var and mutate it. Let's update everywhere that's using the const to plumb the new value set by the config instead.

> I think this is a dangerous change; we shouldn't swap out the const to a var and mutate it. Let's update everywhere that's using the const to plumb the new value set by the config instead.

Hi, @ehashman 
I don't understand why it's dangerous to use var. The value of var comes from kubelet config, and no other setting.

It looks like this was being used in https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/9642a1f84b97582c29142a9c04d0c25c5632ad08/pkg/kubelet/kuberuntime/helpers.go#L185-L189 which has not been updated. We need to ensure that value set by the kubelet config gets set there. I don't like the idea of declaring this as a `var` instead of const; let's find a way to correctly pass the specified value.
